title: DEMOCRATS ARE IN TROUBLE
tags: the culture war with tim pool
description:
New polling shows Republicans leading Democrats in favorability ahead of the midterms, while Democrats post historically low numbers for this stage of the cycle. The data indicates a significant drop compared to previous elections where Democrats typically held an advantage. The shift points to Republicans gaining ground with independents and competitive districts that will decide control of Congress.
